## Types

### type Confidence

```go
type Confidence float64
```

Confidence is a detection certainty between 0.0 and 1.0.

The built-in fingerprinters use a shared scale (see FINGERPRINTS.md):

	1.00  ConfidenceCertain  a response no other protocol produces, cross-checked
	                         (echoed identifiers, CRCs, decoded identity)
	0.90  ConfidenceHigh     the protocol's framing and handshake, fully valid
	0.60  ConfidenceMedium   valid framing, but a check could not be made
	0.30  ConfidenceLow      a hint: shape matches, nothing cross-checked

```go
const (
	ConfidenceNone    Confidence = 0.0
	ConfidenceLow     Confidence = 0.3
	ConfidenceMedium  Confidence = 0.6
	ConfidenceHigh    Confidence = 0.9
	ConfidenceCertain Confidence = 1.0
)
```

Confidence levels shared by the built-in fingerprinters.

```go
const MatchThreshold Confidence = 0.5
```

MatchThreshold is the lowest confidence a fingerprinter reports as Matched. Below it a result is a hint: Matched is false and Confidence says how close it came.

#### func (Confidence) Clamp

```go
func (c Confidence) Clamp() Confidence
```

Clamp returns c limited to \[0.0, 1.0].

#### func (Confidence) IsHigh

```go
func (c Confidence) IsHigh(threshold Confidence) bool
```

IsHigh reports whether c is at least threshold.

#### func (Confidence) Valid

```go
func (c Confidence) Valid() bool
```

Valid reports whether c is within \[0.0, 1.0].

### type EngineConfig

```go
type EngineConfig struct {
	// Mode is passed to each fingerprinter: ModeDetect or ModeIdentify.
	Mode Mode

	// Trace records raw exchanges in each Result.
	Trace bool

	// Protocols, when non-empty, restricts the scan to these protocols.
	Protocols []Protocol

	// Exclude removes protocols from the scan.
	Exclude []Protocol

	// MaxIntrusiveness skips fingerprinters that send more than this.
	// The zero value, Passive, skips the ReadOnly ones (SunSpec); set
	// ReadOnly to run all.
	MaxIntrusiveness Intrusiveness

	// LikelyOnly runs only the fingerprinters whose well-known ports
	// include the target port, falling back to all when none does.
	LikelyOnly bool

	// EarlyStop stops after the first result with Confidence at least
	// HighConfidenceThreshold. Fingerprinters that refine the matched
	// protocol (SunSpec refines Modbus) still run.
	EarlyStop bool

	// HighConfidenceThreshold is the early-stop threshold. Zero means
	// ConfidenceHigh.
	HighConfidenceThreshold Confidence

	// StopOnRefused stops a scan when a TCP connection is refused:
	// nothing listens on the port, so no other TCP fingerprinter can
	// succeed either. It has no effect on UDP targets.
	StopOnRefused bool

	// Parallel runs fingerprinters concurrently. Many field devices accept
	// a single TCP connection only; leave it off for OT networks.
	Parallel bool

	// MaxConcurrency bounds Parallel. Zero or negative is unbounded.
	MaxConcurrency int

	// MinInterval is the minimum delay between starting two
	// fingerprinters, to stay below IDS rate thresholds.
	MinInterval time.Duration

	// Observer receives progress callbacks. Nil disables them.
	Observer Observer

	// Logger receives debug output. Nil is silent.
	Logger Logger
}
```

EngineConfig configures an Engine. The zero value runs every applicable fingerprinter sequentially in detect mode, without early stop.

#### func DefaultEngineConfig

```go
func DefaultEngineConfig() EngineConfig
```

DefaultEngineConfig returns the configuration the otfp package and the otprobe CLI use: sequential, early stop at ConfidenceHigh, stop when the port refuses connections, read-only probes allowed, detect mode.

#### func SafeEngineConfig

```go
func SafeEngineConfig() EngineConfig
```

SafeEngineConfig returns a conservative configuration for production OT networks: DefaultEngineConfig limited to passive probes, the likely protocols of the port first and only, and 250 ms between probes.

### type Fingerprinter

```go
type Fingerprinter interface {
	// Info describes the fingerprinter. It must return the same value on
	// every call.
	Info() Info

	// Detect probes target. A non-nil error means detection could not
	// decide (the endpoint was unreachable or timed out); a response that
	// is merely not this protocol is a NoMatch result with a nil error.
	Detect(ctx context.Context, target Target, opts Options) (Result, error)
}
```

Fingerprinter detects one protocol. Implementations must be safe for concurrent use, honour ctx and Target.Timeout, and never panic on any response.

### type Intrusiveness

```go
type Intrusiveness uint8
```

Intrusiveness grades what a fingerprinter puts on the wire, so that careful scans can skip the noisier ones.

```go
const (
	// Passive fingerprinters send a protocol's standard connection
	// handshake or discovery request only (COTP CR, HEL, Who-Is,
	// ListIdentity, STARTDT, WebSocket upgrade, HTTP GET).
	Passive Intrusiveness = iota
	// ReadOnly fingerprinters also send read requests to application
	// data, such as Modbus holding registers for the SunSpec marker.
	ReadOnly
)
```

### type Protocol

```go
type Protocol uint8
```

Protocol identifies an OT protocol. The numeric values are stable across versions: new protocols are appended, existing ones are never renumbered.

```go
const (
	ProtocolUnknown    Protocol = 0
	ProtocolModbus     Protocol = 1
	ProtocolMMS        Protocol = 2
	ProtocolS7         Protocol = 3
	ProtocolOPCUA      Protocol = 4
	ProtocolBACnet     Protocol = 5
	ProtocolCAN        Protocol = 6
	ProtocolPROFINET   Protocol = 7
	ProtocolDNP3       Protocol = 8
	ProtocolIEC104     Protocol = 9
	ProtocolENIP       Protocol = 10
	ProtocolSunSpec    Protocol = 11
	ProtocolOCPP       Protocol = 12
	ProtocolIEEE2030_5 Protocol = 13 //nolint:revive // the standard's name
	ProtocolOpenADR    Protocol = 14
	ProtocolKNX        Protocol = 15
	ProtocolMQTT       Protocol = 16
	ProtocolSparkplugB Protocol = 17
	ProtocolCANopen    Protocol = 18
	// unexported sentinel
)
```

### type Result

```go
type Result struct {
	Protocol   Protocol   `json:"protocol"`
	Matched    bool       `json:"matched"`
	Confidence Confidence `json:"confidence"`

	// Variant refines the protocol: "S7comm-plus", "OCPP 2.0.1",
	// "OpenADR 3", "BACnet/IP (BVLC)", "opc.tcp" ...
	Variant string `json:"variant,omitempty"`

	// Details is a short human-readable explanation.
	Details string `json:"details,omitempty"`

	// Evidence lists the checks that passed, in the order made.
	Evidence []string `json:"evidence,omitempty"`

	// Identity is set when Options.Mode is ModeIdentify and the endpoint
	// answered an identity request.
	Identity *Identity `json:"identity,omitempty"`

	// Fingerprint is a stable signature of the response.
	Fingerprint *Fingerprint `json:"fingerprint,omitempty"`

	// Error records why detection could not decide, e.g. a timeout or a
	// refused connection. A non-nil Error always comes with Matched false.
	Error error `json:"-"`

	// DetectionID uniquely identifies this attempt, for audit trails.
	DetectionID string `json:"detectionId"`
	// Timestamp is when the attempt finished.
	Timestamp time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
	// Duration is how long the attempt took (set by the engine).
	Duration time.Duration `json:"duration"`

	// Exchanges are the raw probe/response pairs when Options.Trace is set.
	Exchanges []Exchange `json:"exchanges,omitempty"`
}
```

Result is the outcome of one fingerprinter on one target.

	Outcome              Matched  Confidence        Error
	identified           true     >= MatchThreshold nil
	hint                 false    (0, threshold)    nil
	not this protocol    false    0                 nil
	could not tell       false    0                 *TimeoutError, *ConnectionError, ...

### type Target

```go
type Target struct {
	// Host is an IP address or a host name.
	Host string

	// Port is the TCP or UDP port.
	Port int

	// Network restricts detection to fingerprinters of one transport. The
	// zero value is TCP. Use UDP to probe BACnet/IP, the EtherNet/IP
	// ListIdentity service on UDP or PROFINET's DCE/RPC endpoint.
	Network Network

	// Timeout bounds each dial, write and read of a fingerprinter. The
	// zero value is DefaultTimeout.
	Timeout time.Duration

	// TLS, when non-nil, makes TCP fingerprinters run over TLS with this
	// configuration: Modbus/TCP Security, IEC 62351-3 for IEC 104 and
	// DNP3, EtherNet/IP over TLS, OCPP over wss://, OpenADR over HTTPS.
	// ServerName defaults to Host. Fingerprinters that negotiate TLS
	// themselves (IEEE 2030.5) start from a clone of it.
	TLS *tls.Config

	// Path, when set, overrides the WebSocket path OCPP tries first. The
	// IEEE 2030.5 and OpenADR fingerprinters probe their standard paths and
	// ignore it.
	Path string
}
```

Target is the endpoint to fingerprint.
